name: DPT
toxicities: FreeODwiki says recreational toxicity and long-term health effects of DPT appear not to have been studied and exact toxic dose is unknown.
effectsSummary: FreeODwiki describes DPT as a psychedelic tryptamine with reported bodily euphoria and psychedelic effects; reports and dose information are anecdotal.
dosageRemark: The archive gives three route tables: insufflated threshold 10 mg, light 15-20 mg, moderate 20-50 mg, strong 50-100 mg, heavy 100 mg+; oral threshold 50 mg, light 75-150 mg, moderate 150-250 mg, strong 250-350 mg, heavy 350 mg+; smoked threshold 5 mg, light 20-50 mg, moderate 50-100 mg, strong 100-200 mg, heavy 200 mg+. Times vary by route as stated in the archive. User/resource educational tables, not recommendations. Duplicate inhaled/smoked rows were consolidated as smoked; lightMin follows each source light lower bound.
generalRisks: The archived page says toxicity and long-term health effects appear unstudied and exact toxic dose unknown; its dosage information is user/resource material and should be cross-checked.
longtermRisks: The archived page says recreational toxicity and long-term health effects of DPT appear not to have been studied.
saferUse: FreeODwiki recommends harm reduction and cross-checking its user/resource dose information with other sources.
